raw_content.initial_message: This is the THIRD time pickup didn’t happen. Just refund me already.
raw_content.context: Return pickup has failed multiple times. Policy: apologize, acknowledge inconvenience, reschedule with priority/escalation to logistics, offer drop-off option if available, explain refund timeline once pickup is confirmed, and provide next update time. Avoid sounding robotic.

learning_objectives: De-escalate when the customer feels disrespected
Fix broken process with ownership and concrete action
correct_sop_steps: Apologize and acknowledge inconvenience (missed pickups waste time)
Confirm return details and last scheduled pickup attempts
Escalate to logistics/courier with priority and reschedule pickup with a firm window
Offer alternate option: drop-off location or new label if available
Explain refund timeline: refund starts after pickup scan/return initiated
Set next update time and commit to follow-up
common_mistakes: Giving generic apology with no action
Promising refund before return is initiated (if policy disallows)
sticky_notes: KEY: Customer is angry because their time was wasted — show ownership.
TRAP: Don’t promise instant refund unless policy supports it.
HINT: Provide one clear plan and timeline.

bonus_points: Summarizes plan in one short message

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if you prioritize and reschedule with a firm window and commit to follow-up
